name: Blight Creep
description: Let a creeping blight spread through the legs of a group of foes and slow their advance.

name: Rotting Seizure
description: Seize a foe in rotting qi that locks the joints and spoils the flesh around them.

name: Fever Dissolution
description: Dissolve the fever of a rotting plague in an ally by letting the heat fall out through the skin.

name: Hollowing Thrust
description: Thrust a hand through the guard and hollow out the vitality of the chest behind it.

name: Great Wither
description: Draw the wither out across the field until every living thing in it droops and fails.

name: Plaguerot Mantle
description: Wear a mantle of pestilent qi that rots weapons and weakens all who press close.

name: Rotwave Lance
description: Hurl a lance of rot through ranks of foes that spoils everything along its length.

name: Merciful Ending
description: Bring a deadly plague in many allies to a gentle close so it ends in each.

name: Age Collapse
description: Age every structure and body in a wide ring by decades so that the weak ones fall apart.

name: Withering Dominion
description: Claim the field as a dominion of ending in which foes weaken and allies are left whole.

name: Mortal Reckoning
description: Call down a reckoning on one foe that takes vitality no armour or ward can hold back.

name: Wasting Sovereign
description: The school's great wasting whose reach and depth follow the qi the master pours into the field.

name: World Wither
description: Wither every living thing across a wide land at once up to the destructive ceiling of a death master of this tier.

name: Cycle Wane
description: Let the natural wane of a cycle fall on a foe so each function slows and settles.

name: Closing Hold
description: Close a still hold about a foe's whole body and keep it there until the cycle ends.

name: Cycle Release
description: Release an ally from a failing poison by letting its cycle reach its end and fall away.

name: Terminal Palm
description: Strike with a palm at the end of a breath so the blow arrives with the weight of completion.

name: Cycle Collapse
description: Collapse the working of every living cycle in a wide ring so all within fail together.

name: Cycle Mantle
description: Wear a mantle of the closing cycle that draws the force from every blow and weakens the striker.

name: Closing Thrust
description: Thrust the ending of a cycle through a foe so that its remaining life closes behind it.

name: Cycle Absolution
description: Bring the long cycle of a curse in an ally to its natural end so it falls away whole.

name: Divine Wane
description: Let a divine wane fall across a great ring and pull strength out of everything alive within it.

name: Closing Edict
description: Pronounce the close of a foe's strength and hold it ended for as long as the edict stands.

name: Cycle Sentence
description: Pass the verdict of the cycle on one foe and take vitality that no defence can turn aside.

name: Entropy Throne
description: The school's seat of entropy that shields the master and wearies every foe near it by the qi given.

name: Closing Sovereignty
description: The school's sovereign closing that ends the strength of all foes in the field in proportion to the divine qi given.

name: Cessation Swell
description: Send a wave of cessation across a whole region that stills the living up to the destructive ceiling of a divine death master.

name: Natural Completion
description: Bring every cycle in a vast circle to its natural completion at once up to the destructive ceiling of this tier.
